selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want after leaving the classroom?
questions.answer: He wanted his faith to grow stronger and clearer.

questions.question: Were only a few guides there, or very many?
questions.answer: Very many were there.

questions.question: Who invited him into the next gathering?
questions.answer: Spiritual teachers invited him.

questions.question: What did these guides have in common?
questions.answer: They were all seeking truth through the Prophetic way.

questions.question: Which beloved messenger’s way gave shade to their journey?
questions.answer: The way of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What two things in the passage supported their declaration?
questions.answer: Their spiritual discoveries and their wondrous gifts supported it.

questions.question: Even though the saints had different ways, what was the same?
questions.answer: They all agreed about Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What example from nature helps explain this idea?
questions.answer: The passage uses sunlight and its colors.

questions.question: What big idea does the traveler understand from the agreement of so many people?
questions.answer: He understands that the truth about Allah is shining clearly.

questions.question: Say the main message of the passage in one short sentence.
questions.answer: Many righteous people agreed that Allah alone is truly worthy of worship.

questions.question: From what level of faith did the traveler want to move higher?
questions.answer: He wanted to go from knowing with certainty to seeing with certainty.

questions.question: What kind of certainty did he want to reach?
questions.answer: He wanted a higher kind of certainty, like seeing the truth more clearly.

questions.question: Who were the people he met next?
questions.answer: He met many saintly guides.

questions.question: What was their goal?
questions.answer: Their goal was to reach truth with clear certainty.

questions.question: What were the holy guides declaring together?
questions.answer: They were declaring Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What picture is used to help explain the saints’ many different ways?
questions.answer: The passage compares them to many colors of light.

questions.question: What can we learn from the fact that they all agreed?
questions.answer: We can learn that the truth they saw was very clear and strong.

questions.question: Do different paths always mean different beliefs in this passage?
questions.answer: No. Their paths were different, but their belief about Allah was the same.

questions.question: Which is brighter than daylight in the passage?
questions.answer: The joined agreement of prophets, scholars, and saints is described that way.

questions.question: What was greater than the saints’ witness alone?
questions.answer: The shared agreement of prophets, scholars, and saints together was greater.

questions.question: After leaving the classroom, what did the traveler deeply hope to see?
questions.answer: He hoped to see the light of faith becoming stronger and growing.

questions.question: Who gathered there?
questions.answer: Spiritual guides and saintly people gathered there.

questions.question: What main belief were they all announcing?
questions.answer: They were announcing that Allah must exist and that He is One.

questions.question: Did he go to a lonely place or a gathering place?
questions.answer: He went to a gathering place.
